{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are consistently too low in early horizons, showing significant undershoot that gradually converges to match true outcomes",
    "Sentiment positively correlates with price movements, with high sentiment (1.00) aligning with price increases and negative sentiment with declines",
    "The gap between model forecasts and true outcomes increases with forecast horizon, especially visible in the first 10-15 days of the 30-day forecast",
    "Model exhibits mean-reversion bias, forecasting prices that are too close to recent averages when true prices show more momentum",
    "Sentiment amplifies price deviations from model forecasts, with high sentiment periods showing larger differences than low/neutral sentiment",
    "Price levels below ~67.50 show exaggerated model-true outcome differences, suggesting the model underperforms in low price ranges",
    "Model fails to fully capture price volatility spikes, particularly when sentiment is strongly positive (1.00)",
    "The forecast lag effect is most pronounced on trading days following significant price changes in the history"
] }
